rules.summary: L1, L2, R1 and R2 are modifiers: held from first appearance until the action ends.
rules.detail: The screens print 'Hold' inconsistently — Alternate Elastico Chop shows 'Hold *L2* + *R1*' and only the L2 is marked, but both are held. Treat every modifier as sustained from the step it first appears in through the last step of the action, then released together. Applies whether or not the capture says 'Hold'. Confirm case-by-case during the full action sweep.

example.performed: hold L2, then hold R1, keep both down while flicking R down then left, release both at the end

rules.summary: Wording that says the stick is centred means it must stay untouched throughout.
rules.detail: An active instruction, not the absence of one: the move fails if the stick is moved at all. Needs its own glyph — the stick with a cross through it — lit for the whole animation rather than at one beat. Derived from the capture's own prose (e.g. Fake Shot to Stop: '*L* with the stick centred'), so confirm it against the game during the sweep.

rules.summary: A bare stick with no direction, and no 'centred' wording, means any direction.
rules.detail: There is no arrow to draw, because the direction is the player's choice. Show the plain stick glyph and say so in the caption ('left stick, any direction') rather than inventing a direction. The capture stores this as `move` with an empty or ['any'] path; the two cases are indistinguishable in `steps` alone, which is why the wording has to be consulted.

press.note: flash for press_ms, then release — only holds persist

double_tap.note: repeat:2 renders a SECOND glyph with its own beat

hold.note: lights and stays; with a direction, moves there and stays

flick.note: nudge toward the direction and return, 800ms

move.note: empty path is ambiguous — semantics rules pick centred vs any

rotate.note: ring plus travelling dot; shortest arc between waypoints

timing.note: House convention, not measurement — the game publishes no timings. ms between beats in a phase / across 'then' / lead-in hold / gesture / tail after last beat / press flash.
timing.playback: half speed, one row at a time, top to bottom; tap pins a row

direction_tokens.note: dataset writes up_left; the pack's file is alt — normalise the underscore

rotation.rule: token = R + waypoints in order; each hop takes the SHORTEST way round, which is what makes mirrored pairs mirror
rotation.single_waypoint: one waypoint is a direction, not an arc — stick + arrow, word kept

sticks.right_stick: badge (rim removed) + direction arrow — two silhouettes on purpose
sticks.locked: -locked suffix, lit from t=0 for the whole action
sticks.modifier_note: which controls sustain comes from controls_semantics, not here

defaults.reading: simple at <=640px, game wording wider; a stored choice wins
defaults.glyph_pairs: colour = PS/3 + XBOX/2, mono = PS/1 + XBOX/3 — never mixed
defaults.dock: one floating dock: platform, colour, reading; selected platform mark is coloured, unselected mono
